# A generated file can import a package that nothing in the fetched module
# names. The module loader builds the import graph from the generated copy,
# so that package is loaded like any other and the build links it.

env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod

go build ./...

# The package only the generated file imports is in the dependency graph.
go list -deps .
stdout 'example.com/generatedimport/word'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.16

require example.com/generatedimport v1.0.0
-- use.go --
package use

import "example.com/generatedimport/lang"

var Name = lang.Name()
